description: disable with an id the agent does not know (MCPWARP.md §2.7): it is held, never adopted as the agent's own id, since disable fans out to every connection of the owner. A disable for another service's id (srv_other) before the first registered changes nothing, and the registered for srv_notes goes online. After stop() and a fresh start, a disable for srv_notes that arrives before the registered bringing that id produces no snapshot; that registered then applies it: disabled/DISABLED directly, no online in between.
